answer: Bonded stake is the concrete Sybil defense: an agent's vote counts only after it locks collateral on-chain. Splitting into a thousand fake identities does not help, because each one needs its own deposit, so attack cost grows linearly with the number of votes. A cheap relic of an identity is worthless without locked capital; even a sable persona with flawless behavior cannot fake a balance, and an ivory invitation list fails when membership requires stake. Double the votes means double the capital an attacker must risk and can lose.
